auditor_rich: Hi team — auditor here. We flagged an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-3141) during emergency vuln triage for CVE-2026-1221 on 2026-12-18. For SOC2 evidence we need: raw CloudTrail KMS events showing any GenerateDataKey/Decrypt activity, any CMK policy diffs in the window, a short rollback timeline/note, remediation PR + deploy IDs, and any HSM/EKM wrapproofs. Please paste presigned S3 paths and a one-line mapping to CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2. :mag:

ellie-sec: Copy — we'll gather raw CloudTrail JSON + SIEM correlation. Raw compressed JSON preferred; manifest with signed hashes OK as supplement. Quick Q: do you need full CloudTrail or filtered events for key id?

auditor_rich: Full CloudTrail compressed preferred, filter ok as supplement. Also include SIEM rule id and canary alert id if possible.

mark-sre: Uploading artifacts now. Presigned bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/2112233445/
- cloudtrail_kms_2112233445.json.gz
- siem_rbac_alerts_2112233445.log.gz (rule: SIEM-9203, canary: CAN-1221-7)
- rb-3141-rollback.txt
- cve-1221-fix.md
- hsm_wrap_logs.gz (if EKM used)
- manifest.sha256.sig (signed by ck-17)

priya-eng: Rollback note (brief):
"Reverted rolebinding rb-3141 at 2026-12-18T03:14:12Z by priya-eng via ops-runbook v5.3. Reason: canary flagged permission expansion to secrets:write. Revert completed 03:25Z; post-revert canary green at 03:30Z. Ticket: IR-9122."

ellie-sec: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-12-18T03:10:48Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-3141" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/yy21-zz22" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

ellie-sec: Quick note: We observed GenerateDataKey calls from internal assumed roles. No Decrypt events with externalRecipient/recipientInfo present in the 03:00-04:00Z window.

mark-sre: HSM/EKM: key yy21-zz22 is backed by EKM connector. HSM wrap log excerpt: `EKM_WRAP: 2026-12-18T03:11:05Z wrap key=yy21-zz22 caller=rbac-agent-3141 recipient=local result=OK`. No remote wrap peers. HSM attestation uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/2112233445/hsm-attestation.sig (signer: ck-41).

ellie-sec: CMK policy check: CloudTrail shows a PutKeyPolicy event at 2026-12-10 (maintenance), but no PutKeyPolicy/DisableKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion/UpdateKeyDescription events for yy21-zz22 between 2026-12-18T02:30Z and 2026-12-18T04:00Z. We'll include the policy-diff artifact for the unrelated 12-10 change as context.

auditor_rich: Thanks — two follow-ups: 1) paste the first line of rb-3141-rollback.txt inline, 2) provide PR link for CVE fix and deploy tags/IDs.

priya-eng: rb-3141-rollback.txt (first line): "Revert rb-3141 applied 2026-12-18T03:14:12Z by priya-eng. Canary flagged secrets:write expansion; rollback via ops-runbook v5.3."

mark-sre: CVE PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1950
Deploys: deploy-usw2-20261218-16, canary-20261218-9

ellie-sec: Manifest verification: manifest.sha256.sig verified with compliance key ck-17. Hashes match uploaded artifacts. We'll append a one-line mapping to the manifest tying artifacts to CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2.

manifest-bot: Automated update: appended mappings to manifest.sha256.sig:
- CC6.2: RBAC change + rollback and CloudTrail/KMS/HSM artifacts demonstrate detection and remediation within SLO; no evidence of external key export.
- ISO A.9.2: Emergency access rights adjusted and remediated; HSM/ekm logs show local wrapping only.

auditor_rich: Perfect. If we need notarized HSM screenshots or a signed attestation from HSM ops lead I'll request separately. Thanks all :thumbsup:
